about.title: About Us
about.historyText:
JAGUAR LLAQTA begins its operations in Cusco, Peru, as an alternative tourism project born from a conscious and respectful perspective, deeply linked to nature and the living culture of the country. We design authentic experiences that connect travelers with nature and native communities.

This tourism project arises from the need to generate a different way of traveling, of learning, exploring the world through authentic and transcendental experiences. A different perspective on tourism. Genuinely connecting with sacred places, their people and traditions.

It is a Peruvian initiative in search of the recognition of roots, origins and culture. Revaluing the knowledge of communities and preserving nature. Supported by a group of professionals with extensive experience in alternative tourism, work with native communities and nature, and tourism administration.
about.visionText: We hold the vision of becoming an alternative tourism project recognized for its ethics, authenticity and commitment. Generating a positive impact on the native communities we work with, contributing to the environmental and cultural awareness of travelers, industry companies and local stakeholders.
about.missionText: Our mission is to offer nature tourism experiences, hikes and cultural experiences developed with deep respect for the environment and local communities, promoting the revaluation of Peru's ancestral culture through alternative routes.
about.objectiveTwo: Promote knowledge and respect for native communities
about.objectiveThree: Inform and educate about ancestral traditions and living culture
about.authenticityDesc: We believe in responsible tourism as a tool for change and learning.
about.respectDesc: We have a team of trained professionals with years of experience in the field.
about.commitmentDesc: We offer a format that allows travelers to immerse in the nature they traverse and be nourished by the native communities they interact with.
about.teamText: Our team of local guides and collaborators, committed to offering authentic experiences.
about.organizationsText: We work hand in hand with local communities, spiritual masters and organizations committed to sustainable tourism.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: No. We have different routes with varying levels of difficulty. During the Pre-Booking we will ask you to honestly answer some screening questions to confirm if the chosen route is right for you.
faq.q2: Can I do a tour alone?
faq.a2: Yes. Although tours indicate the minimum recommended number of people for the suggested price, you have the option to request a private tour. Keep in mind that this would result in increased service costs.
faq.q3: What should I bring to the tour?
faq.a3: All our routes and experiences are detailed on the website, specifying what items are recommended for each specific tour.
faq.q4: How do I make my payment?
faq.a4: We currently have payment options via cash, bank transfer, and digital wallets (Remitly, Global66, Yape, Plin). For any other payment method, please contact us by email or phone. Please note that any bank charges or additional fees will be assumed by the client or person making the deposit.
faq.q5: Does the tour include sleeping bag, tent, trekking poles, etc.?
faq.a5: The tour does not include mountain equipment beyond what is mentioned as part of each route. On Multi-Day routes, each participant needs a sleeping bag for camping. Inflatable air mattresses and trekking poles (with rubber tips) are optional but recommended. If you do not wish to bring any of the above, all are available for rent. Please notify in advance.
